name: master-suite
product: Signal Studio — Notes, Tasks and Timeline as one running application on one world of data

notes.master: _gate-suite.html is written by tools/wrap.mjs from master.html. master.html is page CONTENT — no doctype, html, head or body — because the published artifact supplies the skeleton. Nothing can open it as a file without one, so every gate opens the wrapped copy.
notes.states: The suite answers ?state=<product>.<state> as well as its own ?p= and ?state=. The compound form exists so a toolchain that can set one parameter can reach all three products. Folded from the full space: Tasks ships 6 states, Notes 10, Timeline 14 — thirty in all. The eight here are the ones a defect would be found in; the folds are recorded in brief.md. A DOT and not a colon: a state name is also a filename, and the shot harness names every frame after its state — a colon collapsed forty frames into three on Windows without erroring.
notes.variants: paper and ink are Timeline's two ratified grounds. Tasks and Notes have no ground decision and ignore ?v= at these values, which is correct: they are the ink-floor products and the ground decision was only ever Timeline's.
notes.ladders: sizes and spaces are EMPTY DELIBERATELY, and this is a known gap, not an oversight. The source ladders read the stylesheets, and this artefact carries three products with three separately declared and separately ratified ladders — Timeline invented its own material system by name in its lock. One config cannot hold three. Each product is held to its OWN ladders by tools/gates.mjs, which repoints the three engagements' own audits at this file; this config covers what is genuinely cross-product: the palette, the families, the weights, contrast, targets, radii, motion and leading, at five viewports across all three surfaces.
notes.palette: Indigo deep #4338ca is the indigo ramp one step darker. It is declared in both the Tasks and Notes shells as --indigo-deep and was part of the three-colour lock's own reading of itself from the first round of both engagements.
notes.typeRamp: The union of the three products' ramps, and it is a UNION rather than a law — Timeline declares thirteen steps and gates them, Notes declares eight and gates them, Tasks declares none and its own audit has never had a ramp check. 14 is here because the Tasks card title, the most-read string on the board, is set at 14 and is on no ramp declared in that lab; 16 is here because the screen-reader live regions inherit it at a 1x1 box nobody sees. Both are recorded as observations in round 1 rather than smuggled in as law.
